The investigation into the failing test cases is complete, and the intended behavior has been captured in `requirement.feature`.

### Summary of Investigation
- **Failing Tests Tracing**: When an [`XYPlot`](file:///Users/nothing/prometheus_workdir_microstudy/chart_4_group_c_arch/source/org/jfree/chart/plot/XYPlot.java) has a dataset mapped to an axis but does not have an assigned renderer (such as during chart instantiation in `ChartFactory` or when `plot.setRenderer(null)` is called), querying the axis data range via [`getDataRange(ValueAxis axis)`](file:///Users/nothing/prometheus_workdir_microstudy/chart_4_group_c_arch/source/org/jfree/chart/plot/XYPlot.java#L4425-L4518) results in a `NullPointerException`.
- **Intended Behavior**: When an axis data range is computed on an [`XYPlot`](file:///Users/nothing/prometheus_workdir_microstudy/chart_4_group_c_arch/source/org/jfree/chart/plot/XYPlot.java) where the renderer for a dataset is `null`, the data range should be determined directly from the dataset's values without throwing an exception.

The black-box specification has been saved to [requirement.feature](file:///Users/nothing/prometheus_workdir_microstudy/chart_4_group_c_arch/requirement.feature).
